title: CDR for NER & RPEQ Engineering Registers
description: Prepare competency documentation for national and state engineering registers, including the National Engineering Register and RPEQ.

data.sub: Get your name on recognised engineering registers.

items.title: NER
items.text: National Engineering Register, kept by Engineers Australia.

items.title: RPEQ
items.text: Registered Professional Engineer of Queensland, kept by BPEQ.

items.q: Is registration required to work as an engineer?
items.a: It depends on the register and the state. For example, Queensland requires RPEQ registration to provide professional engineering services there. Check the rules for the place you work.

items.q: Can you help with other state registers?
items.a: Contact us with your state and goal and we will confirm what support is available.
